kazhydromet_winter_2026_27.issuer: RSE Kazhydromet, Hydrometeorological Centre (Ministry of Ecology and Natural Resources, Kazakhstan)
kazhydromet_winter_2026_27.document: СЕЗОННЫЙ ПРОГНОЗ ПОГОДЫ. Декабрь 2026 года – февраль 2027 года
kazhydromet_winter_2026_27.spatial_scale: 17 oblasts of Kazakhstan; no separate mountain-zone forecast

december_2026.temperature: above normal by 1-2 C over most of the country; near normal in the east of Almaty oblast
december_2026.precipitation: near normal across the whole country

january_2027.temperature: above normal by 1-2 C over most of the country (Almaty oblast not listed among near-normal areas)
january_2027.precipitation: below normal in the northern half of Almaty oblast

february_2027.temperature: above normal by 1-3 C over most of the country (Almaty oblast not listed among near-normal areas)
february_2027.precipitation: above normal over most of the country (Almaty oblast not listed among the exceptions)

kazhydromet_winter_2026_27.issue_schedule: six issues per year; the winter (Dec-Feb) issue on 15 November
kazhydromet_winter_2026_27.caveat: Oblast-scale and advisory. Almaty oblast spans roughly 500-5000 m; a single oblast statement cannot be read as a forecast for the 1271-3318 m study area, and it says nothing about snow depth.

c3s_november_2026.issuer: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) multi-system seasonal forecast
c3s_november_2026.period: DJF 2026/27 onward, at least six months ahead
c3s_november_2026.published_highlights: ENSO expected to peak around the end of 2026; eastern Asia listed among wetter-than-average regions
c3s_november_2026.what_we_could_not_read: The C3S anomaly charts are rendered client-side; no Central Asia / Kazakhstan anomaly value could be read programmatically on 2026-11-19. The chart URLs above are given so a reader can check them directly.
c3s_november_2026.caveat: Seasonal forecasts are probabilistic and coarse-resolution. C3S publishes verification plots; skill over Central Asia in winter is limited and must be checked before any operational use.
